text_block_list.text:
One morning, I notice Нарита Таисин
talking to
someone in front of her dorm.
Anyway, take care, Taishin! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Actually, wait. You said you sprained
your ankle,
didn't you?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
And didn't you mention that you're out
of your
favorite medical tape?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. It's nothing.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Later.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, it's you.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
My roommate, Супер Крик. You know
her?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Sort of. Are you two close?

text_block_list.text:
Does it seem that way? I guess we're
closer than
we used to be.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: We fought a lot when we first met.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Taishin, you're such a good
Umamusume! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Huh? Are you making fun of me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Of course not! Now, don't be shy and—
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Get away! Just leave me alone!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: What? Oh... I, uh...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
We barely spoke to each other after
that, but
then we started chatting a tiny
bit from then on.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: And now we're here, I guess.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: So you two hashed it out?

text_block_list.text:
Not really. I just put up with her. She
does all
sorts of stuff in our room, but
it's not like it bugs
me.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
And it's not like I wanna get into fights
or
anything. Anyway, aren't we supposed
to go
train?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: That night...

Hey, you. Got a moment? Creek hasn't
come
home yet.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's okay. It's not like I care
since
we're not friends or anything, but
still...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: We should go look for her.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right. It'd be a pain if she's
in trouble
or something, so I guess we
should.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huh? Someone's coming. Is that...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I was the one who said I'd tag along on yer shoppin' trip, but I'm barely holdin' it together.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Yer just buyin' everyday things. Why'd
ya hafta
be so picky? You shoulda just
got whatever.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
That won't do! Our little Umamusume is
a delicate
flower.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I pick one thing that really suits her,
then
camouflage it with a few other
items that make it
seem like I didn't try.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Whadda pain in the butt. Yer gonna
exhaust
yerself walkin' on eggshells like
that.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Why don'tcha just lay it all out and be
straight
with her?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: No, it's better not to rush things.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It might take some time, but this is the
right pace
for our friendship.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure one day, I'll be able to see her
real smile.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, you got the patience of a saint.
Is that the
super caring friend thing?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Trainer, let's go.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I thought it was normal, but it turns out
to be the
opposite...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Listen, I...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I'll wait here, then.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: Why don't you wait in your room?

text_block_list.text:
No, I'm staying here. You can go back to
your
place if you want.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: It's okay. I'll wait with you.

text_block_list.text:
Suit yourself. Keep a lookout that way,
then.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, I didn't mean to be out this
late.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Taishin? Were you waiting for me?
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: As if. I just happened to be here.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I couldn't find any medical tape in
the
dorm, so I went out to search for
some.
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: And I found your favorite one! ♪
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: Medical tape? For me?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I don't even need it! Ugh, you're such a
busybody.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: But, Taishin...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if you get home late
because of
me. I don't want that crap.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Give it to my trainer or something.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Bye.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Taishin...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: The next day...
Trainer. Hmph!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Gimme that tape. It's not like you need
it.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Never mind. I was just thinking I've still
got a lot
of growing up to do, that's all.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
She got it for me, so I'll take it—as
payment for
having to wait outside last
night.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
